rights_holder: The animators and the successors to the software publisher
underlying_work: 3D character animation distributed as a software demonstration file
enforcement_history: No litigation found for the animation itself.
curatorial_note: Do not conflate this work with the Lenz takedown litigation, which is commonly called the dancing baby case and concerns a different work entirely: a home video of a toddler dancing to a pop record. The specimen predates modern meme-rights case law by a decade, and its chain of title runs through corporate acquisitions rather than an identifiable author.
